SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.year,
  p.venue,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
WHERE
  p.year = 2022
  AND a.name ILIKE '%jennifer g kim%'
  AND (
    p.title ILIKE '%workplace%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%playbook%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%vr%'
    OR p.title ILIKE '%design of reality%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%workplace%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%playbook%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%vr%'
    OR p.abstract ILIKE '%design of reality%'
  )
ORDER BY
  (CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%workplace%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%playbook%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%vr%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.title ILIKE '%design of reality%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%workplace%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%playbook%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%vr%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END +
   CASE WHEN p.abstract ILIKE '%design of reality%' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ) DESC,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100

sql:
SELECT
  p.corpus_id,
  p.title,
  p.abstract,
  p.canonical_venue,
  p.year,
  p.citation_count
FROM Papers p
LEFT JOIN PaperAuthors pa ON p.corpus_id = pa.corpus_id
LEFT JOIN Authors a ON pa.author_id = a.author_id
WHERE
  (
    p.title ILIKE '%koren%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%lazar%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%ancient akkadian%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%masked language model%' OR
    p.title ILIKE '%language modelling approach%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%ancient akkadian%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%masked language model%' OR
    p.abstract ILIKE '%language modelling approach%'
  )
  OR (
    a.name ILIKE '%koren%' AND a.name ILIKE '%lazar%'
  )
ORDER BY
  CASE
    WHEN p.title ILIKE '%ancient akkadian texts a masked language modelling approach%' THEN 1
    WHEN p.title ILIKE '%ancient akkadian%' AND p.title ILIKE '%masked language%' THEN 2
    WHEN p.title ILIKE '%ancient akkadian%' THEN 3
    WHEN p.title ILIKE '%masked language model%' THEN 4
    WHEN a.name ILIKE '%koren%' AND a.name ILIKE '%lazar%' THEN 5
    ELSE 6
  END,
  p.citation_count DESC
LIMIT 100
